module.name: Pentavox
module.tagline: 2 Plaits voices + 1 sampler, FX chain with stutter/tape/reverb/granular/phaser

actions.label: Next voice page
actions.help: Steps voice pages; from FX returns to the last voice page.

actions.label: Shift layer
actions.help: Voice pages: Level is a stereo VU; moving Level shows its value briefly. B2 top shows that voice's incoming MIDI/CV notes. While held: Plaits Cross FM (Freq pot: how much the other Plaits modulates this one), Attack and Aux send; all sampler shifts; Live Reverse/Filter Resonance/Delay Damp/Reverb Damp/Delay Feedback; Master filter resonances, Phaser Rate and Input To Aux; Granular Scatter/Spread/Reverse; Tone Center/CV amount.

actions.label: Next engine / file
actions.help: Plaits: next engine. Sampler: next file of the slot's SD library (B1-hold + B2: next slot), start when armed, or stop recording.

actions.label: Next bank / Arm
actions.help: Plaits: next bank. Sampler: arm or disarm recording.

actions.label: Stutter (FX Live)
actions.help: Momentary stutter while held, on the clock grid. FX Live only.

actions.label: Settings
actions.help: Hold B2+B3 about two seconds to open Settings.

actions.label: FX pages
actions.help: Enters FX Live; on FX pages steps Live, Granular, Tone.

actions.label: Bypass
actions.help: Release without knob movement to toggle bypass; FX tails freeze.

actions.label: Record knob motion
actions.help: Move a knob while holding; its motion records and loops.

actions.label: Settings
actions.help: Hold B2+B3 about two seconds to open Settings.

jacks.name: Audio In L
jacks.help: Left input to FX and sampler recording.

jacks.name: Audio In R
jacks.help: Right input to FX and sampler recording; level is in Settings.

jacks.name: CV1
jacks.help: J3: assignable in Studio (for example FX freeze); unassigned by default.

jacks.name: CV2
jacks.help: J4: assignable in Studio (for example phaser CV); unassigned by default.

jacks.name: CV5
jacks.help: J7: assignable in Studio (for example bar reset); unassigned by default.

jacks.name: CV6
jacks.help: J8: assignable in Studio; default is clock input.

jacks.name: Audio Out L
jacks.help: Left output after voice mix and FX.

jacks.name: Audio Out R
jacks.help: Right output after voice mix and FX.

manual.preamble: Two Plaits voices and one sampler share six knobs and stutter, tape, filter, drive, phaser, granular and reverb FX.

sections.title: Pages and buttons
sections.body: **B1** cycles Plaits 1-2 and Sampler 1, returning from FX to the last voice. **B3** enters FX Live, then cycles Live/Granular/Tone. Hold **B1** for shift and **B2+B3** for Settings. After changing pages, catch each knob's stored value.

sections.title: FX Live
sections.body: Pots 0-5, top row first, left to right: Stutter Time (B1: Reverse), Filter (centre bypass; B1: Resonance), Delay Mix (B1: Damp), Reverb Mix (B1: Damp), Delay Time (1-4000 ms exponential; B1: Feedback, left pink ping-pong / right blue stereo, white bottom pip at zero), Reverb Size. Hold **B2** to stutter. Stutter Time is bipolar: left pink reverse, right green forward, shortest at the center white bottom pip, longer toward either end; clock divisions mirror on both sides. Clocked Delay Time has13 steps:8/4/2 bars,1 bar,1/2,1/4,1/8,1/8T,1/16,1/16T,1/32,1/32T,1/64; each has one LED position. The buffer holds32 seconds. Reverse and Ping-pong are independent CV/MIDI destinations. Reverb Size no longer changes Damp: set the two separately.

sections.title: Master
sections.body: On the second FX page, top row first: Plaits 1 DJ filter, Phaser Mix (B1: Rate), Plaits 2 DJ filter, Input Level (B1: Input To Aux, the share sent to the effects), Sampler DJ filter and Output Level. The DJ filters have a centre bypass and a resonance under B1. Input Level and Output Level show a stereo peak meter that grows from the top of the ring, left channel to the left; turning the pot shows its value for a second. Phaser Depth and Feedback are set in Studio.

sections.title: MIDI and clock
sections.body: Each voice's MIDI channel is set in CV routing > Notes; Omni accepts every channel. Poly/Unison pool matching Plaits channels, while samplers remain independent. J3-J8 functions are assigned in Studio; by default only J8 is used, as the clock input.

sections.title: Knob record
sections.body: Hold **B3** and move a knob: the motion is recorded and loops after release.

sections.title: Sampler recording
sections.body: On a sampler page hold **B2** to arm. The take starts at the Settings Record Threshold, on the first clock (MIDI clock, MIDI Start or CV clock) when it is set to Clock, on MIDI Start or a reset pulse when it is set to Start or Reset, or with a **B2** tap; Reset+Stop ends on the next reset. Clock Loop waits for a clocked downbeat established by J7 Reset/MIDI Start and records the Settings Record Length (1-16 bars; a slot holds 30 s, so 16 bars need 128 BPM or more). Tap from any page to stop. Both samplers share four slots.

sections.title: SD library
sections.body: Settings > Input & Library selects each slot's WAV: zone 0 loads nothing; later zones pick scanned files. On a sampler page a B2 tap steps to the next file. New takes stay in SDRAM and write to SD when available.

presets.help: Preset slots store the complete state of the module — every page, every setting marked as preset material, and everything else the firmware manages. Slot 0 is the boot slot: it loads automatically at power-up. Presets are saved and named from the web programmer, or from the panel using the module's preset gestures. Slots written by a different firmware version are flagged in the programmer and can be migrated with **Back up all**.
